notes:
High-signal mid-market product org building a knowledge-first search product for B2B customers. Primary objective: reduce manual feature engineering and improve relevance precision via a rerank endpoint. Key evaluation points: (1) offline scoring delta on their annotated eval set (NDCG@10, MRR), (2) p95 latency for rerank endpoint at 1-2x current QPS (target 50-150 qps), (3) cost per 1k rerank calls and pricing path to Dedicated capacity. Started on Hosted API to iterate quickly; intent to move to Dedicated if latency/cost profile and SLAs are acceptable.

POC/technical notes:
- POC scope: 30 days; dataset provided (20k queries + candidate pools). Customer will run offline scoring using Redwood-provided sample runner and compare NDCG and latency. Wants canned eval harness added to repo so engineers can reproduce.
- Model preference: open-model variants first (Llama2/Redwood-curated weights), but product willing to test Redwood-verified optimized variants for latency wins.
- Rerank specifics: will use dedicated rerank endpoint to score top-100 candidates; target top-k improvement in NDCG@10 > 8% relative to baseline. Offline scorer must produce probability/logit outputs for calibration study.
- Throughput & latency targets: expected steady 60 qps with spikes to 200 qps during product events; acceptable p95 latency goal for rerank call is <= 250ms for top-100 re-rank. They prioritize relevance over raw token-cost; willing to pay for Dedicated if unit economics meet SLA requirements.
- Security/compliance: SSO (SAML) mandatory for engineers, audit logs for all inference calls, optional EU data residency for EU customer data. Must see KMS integration and retention policy controls. Redwood asked to fill in security questionnaire (SEC-8790) — customer flagged encryption-at-rest and access controls.

Sales/contract notes:
- Account budget: headroom for mid-five-figure initial FY commitment if POC passes. Estimated ARR target 50k-150k depending on Dedicated commit level.
- Decision makers: VP Product (Eva Lang), Head of Search Eng (Markus Reid), CTO (stop-gate: cost approvals). Procurement timeline: procurement + legal after successful POC, expecting procurement by 2026-06.

Quotes / customer snippets:
- "We can't keep hand-tuning relevance rules; need a repeatable rerank that improves metrics across verticals."
- "Latency is secondary to relevance, but we need consistent p95 under load."

Open asks for Redwood:
- Dedicated pricing sheet with tiers (SLA, throughput, reserved GPUs) + burst pricing
- Example eval harness + sample offline scoring outputs (NDCG/MRR) and runner
- Clarify data residency options and audit log retention windows
- Proposed canary plan for Dedicated migration and rollback behavior
